notes: Organizer-published sessions are official, including booth slots explicitly included in the official schedule.

Coverage includes VTuber guest sessions, workshops, fandom meetup and hololive card-game activities, not all convention programming. Idol Festival check-in/rehearsals are not advertised public guest appearances.
The generic Kumoricon afterparty has no identified VTuber performers and is outside this VTuber schedule.
No blanket photo, video, autograph pricing or international autograph reservation policy is applied to VTuber booth meet-and-greets.

Direct HTTP downloads returned 403. Research used the publicly indexed official pages. The linked 82 MB pocket guide could not be opened by the web reader. Current HTML updates take precedence over the printed guide.
Multiple adjacent windows at the same booth overlap in the published source; no simultaneous devices or stations established.
Opening-hours entries reflect convention-wide and KumoriMarket hours, not promises of individual guest availability.

The supplied agency concert poster explicitly identifies sixteen performers; these are session-specific names, not a roster expansion. Lemi Lichen is now a timed concert participant and the generic pending guest card is removed.

Stellar Verse daily posters confirm start times only. Retain published end times from the convention schedule. Perry, Mogu and Serena poster labels read 11:30PM, corrected by the agency to 11:30AM and corroborated by the convention schedule.
Individual lineups for the Stellar Verse improv panel and BEASTIEZ sessions remain unresolved. The BEASTIEZ poster uses a group portrait without individual name labels.

Post text and image targets were retrieved through the public FXTwitter embed reader; all four attached source images were visually inspected. Downloads remain in ignored tmp storage; source records identify original public posts and image positions.
VTuber scope audited November 12, 2026: only verified VTubers appear in participants/Talent. Other published speakers or performers are retained as credits, not inferred to be VTubers.
